design.edge_per_share: realized_win_rate - avg_entry_price = profit per $1 binary share held to resolution
design.z_score: per-market-bet edge z (independent markets, expected wins = sum of entry prices)
design.market_bet_z: population screen z: one bet per wallet x market x outcome at the share-weighted entry price; supersedes trade_edge_z, whose per-fill variance is understated (fills within a market are perfectly correlated)
design.crop_member: BH-significant (FDR 0.05) one-sided market-bet edge>0 across the volume-gated family AND market_bet_z >= 3.0; the single crop flag downstream consumers read (replaces the retired market_bet_z>=5 cut)
design.caveat: positive edge = private advantage OR manipulation; cannot separate without spot-side identity
